title: Freyliner Transporter

fields.label: Version Added
fields.value: Sometime in June 2025 (a shift in terrain i think)

body:
"A large fitting transport semi truck. Although it can carry a lot, it is substantially slower than most vehicles!"


The Freyliner Transporter is a vehicle that can be purchased for $85,000 from Alan's Auto. It is currently the largest vehicle in Oaklands. It is also one of the slowest, however. It can alternatively be bought for 199 Robux via the terminal next to the central display case

There is also a box upgrade that you can purchase at Alan's Auto for $25,000. This upgrade adds a box and a toggleable truck door. If the box upgrade is used, nothing can detach from the truck. The boxed and unboxed modes can also be switched between, but must be done so close to the vehicle spawner.

Trivia

  • Freyliner Transporter is similar to OptimusVehicle
